mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.8% by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a rising inflation rate signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months signals robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1250 thousand units in the past month signals a weakening in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1250 in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105), a sustained increase in industrial output signals strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.
